interpretation.publicSaveGate: HVP R05 profile.ts intentionally rejects public saves. hvp-world-save, hvpColdWorkerAncestor, hvp-residency-session, hvp-world-replacement, hvpChunkWorldLayout and hvp-game-save hit this gate. hvp-chunk-physics-worker dereferences collisionDigest on a missing public checkpoint. Both hvp-body-mesh-worker failures require the same disabled Checkpoint at line 106.
interpretation.legacyPerformanceHarness: Artifact policy and fixture assume C:/IFI_SourceCode. Negative cases do execute. Positive binding assertions fail on Linux even in synthetic fixtures. hvp-parallel-p03-camera also spawns a Windows-only git.exe absolute path.
interpretation.r4DefaultTimeout: The R4 native worker diagnostic suite first timed out before establishing the next scenario owner. A later Physics is not ready result alone cannot establish a new failure. Compare both complete 30s reruns. A default 5s timeout remains a failed attempt.
interpretation.scope: Other whole-file timeout groups on R4 were outside this paired selection. No public save cutover or reference-device performance is established by these runs.
